description: This file defines the 'State' class and multiple derived classes representing various lifecycle states within a lifecycle management system. It includes state classes such as UnloadedState, LoadingState, InitializingState, etc., each encapsulating behavior related to specific lifecycle states, handling, and context access.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Base class representing a generic lifecycle state, holding a state value and application context, with virtual handle method and accessors.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Unloaded' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Loading' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Initializing' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Paused' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Active' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Suspended' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Hibernated' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Terminating' state. Implements specific 'handle' logic for this state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Virtual method intended for handling state-specific logic; returns true by default.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state value.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the application context associated with the state.
